title: approvals checklist: act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate clause 1 pins PUT 405 Allow on the wire, but both wire doors answer 404 by design (its own pin asserts the 404) - re-word
body:
Filing gate: ① — a checklist clause out of step with an implementation that was not ruled wrong (test-fix / re-word; `pm:queue` takes "说明书脱节 → 修文档").
Path: approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate
QA-source: #24542 · approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate · clause 1
Checklist item priority: P1 (the item fails on this clause ⇒ inherits P1 per the filing-gate grading rule)
type: Task (the product honours its declared contract; the checklist text is what is wrong)
reach: `PUT /api/v1/approvals/act?token=…` on a stock `os dev` showcase boot answered **404** `application/json` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` with no `Allow` header (twice, fresh requests; same for DELETE and PATCH) — the clause expects 405 + `Allow: GET, POST`.

## What is wrong

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`, item `approvals.act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate` (rev 1): the title and acceptance clause 1 say the email action door answers `PUT → 405 with Allow: GET, POST` "through the dispatcher exactly as the self-hosted mount".

Neither wire door answers that, by design:

- the self-hosted mount registers only `GET` and `POST /api/v1/approvals/act` (changeset `.changeset/pre/22578-approvals-action-page-member.md`: "the plugin mounts GET and POST … exactly as before");
- the dispatcher's `/approvals/act` domain claims only GET / HEAD / POST, and "every other method is not claimed and falls through" (`packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals.ts`, the Methods note);
- the item's **own pin** asserts the 404: `packages/runtime/src/domains/approvals-act.test.ts` — an unclaimed PUT is "the dispatcher's ordinary miss", `{ status: 404, code: 'ROUTE_NOT_FOUND' }`, and the member never runs.

The `405` + `Allow: GET, POST` answer belongs to the in-process member `ApprovalService.handleActionPage` only (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts`, "any other method is 405 with Allow"), which no wire request reaches for PUT.

## Reproduction (the QA run's)

1. Boot stock showcase: `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:…/data.db`.
2. As admin, `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/REQUEST_ID/remind` on a pending request; read the act URL from the approver's `sys_notification` `payload.actions`.
3. `PUT /api/v1/approvals/act?token=TOKEN` (no body). Expected per clause 1: 405 + `Allow: GET, POST`. Actual: 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, no `Allow`.

The GET / POST / dead-token legs of the same clause all held (200 confirm page, 200 "Approved", 200 "Invalid link" / "Already used" / "Already decided").

## What to change

Re-word clause 1 (and the title's "PUT 405 Allow: GET, POST") to the shape the product and its pin declare: 405 + `Allow` at the member, an ordinary 404 miss on the wire for any method other than GET / HEAD / POST. Bump `revision`, add a `history` row, keep `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` green.

## Who acts (domain:devx — owns `docs/qa/**` per the pm-dispatch lane table)

The checklist ledger seat (an edit to `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` in one PR). No product code changes.

## Duplicate check

GitHub issue search in objectstack-ai/objectstack, **including closed**: "approvals act PUT 405 Allow GET POST act-door-and-admin-rescue-slate" → 17 hits; "checklist item approvals.act-door clause PUT 404 wire test-fix" → 22 hits. Neither has a card for this clause (nearest: #22438 / #22577 / #22575 — the capability's own landing cards, closed; #23950 — the previous re-point family card, closed, covering six other clauses, not this one).
